xml.payroll.snapshotByPayrollId: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT * FROM brs.deal_commission_snapshot WHERE payroll_id = :payrollId ) AS sub_rows
xml.payroll.getById: SELECT row_to_json(payroll) AS payroll FROM (SELECT p.id, p.period_end AS "periodEnd", p.paid_date AS "paidDate", p.description, p.selected_deal_ids AS "selectedDealIds", ps.payroll_status AS "status", p.current, coalesce((SELECT ARRAY_TO_JSON(array_agg(row_to_json(history))) FROM (SELECT pat.action_type AS "actionType", h.action_date AS "actionDate", concat(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS "actionUser" FROM brs.payroll_action_history h INNER JOIN brs.payroll_action_type pat ON H.payroll_action_type_id = pat.id INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON h.user_id = u.id WHERE h.payroll_id = p.id) history),'[]') AS history FROM brs.payroll p INNER JOIN brs.payroll_status ps ON p.payroll_status_id = ps.id WHERE p.id = :payrollId) payroll
xml.payroll.search:
SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT p.period_end, p.id, p.description, (SELECT sum(dcs1.current_pay) FROM brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs1 WHERE dcs1.payroll_id = p.id) AS current_pay FROM brs.payroll p INNER JOIN brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs ON p.id = dcs.payroll_id INNER JOIN brs.deal d ON dcs.deal_id = d.id LEFT JOIN brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs ON docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE CASE WHEN :startDate:: DATE IS NOT NULL THEN p.period_end BETWEEN :startDate:: DATE AND :endDate:: DATE ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :customerName:: TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN lower(dcs.customer_name) LIKE lower('%' || :customerName:: TEXT || '%') ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :salesRepId:: INTEGER IS NOT NULL THEN d.closer_user_id = :salesRepId:: INTEGER OR docs.user_id = :salesRepId:: INTEGER ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :dealId:: INTEGER IS NOT NULL THEN d.deal_base_oid = :dealId:: INTEGER ELSE 1 = 1 END
GROUP BY p.id, p.period_end ORDER BY p.period_end desc) AS sub_rows
xml.payroll.getApprovedPayrolls: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.period_end FROM brs.payroll p WHERE p.payroll_status_id = 3 -- 3 means APPROVED ORDER BY p.period_end DESC, p.id DESC;
xml.payroll.addCommissionAdjustment: INSERT INTO brs.payroll_adjustment (payroll_id, deal_id, closer_id, amount, note, payroll_adjustment_type_id, created_by, created) VALUES (:payrollId, :dealId, :closerId, :amount, :note, :adjustmentTypeId, :createdById, now());
xml.payroll.getCommissionAdjustments: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(history))) FROM (SELECT pa.closer_id as "closerId", pa.amount, pa.note, pat.adjustment_type as "adjustmentType", pa.created, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS "createdBy" FROM brs.payroll_adjustment pa INNER JOIN brs.payroll_adjustment_type pat ON pa.payroll_adjustment_type_id = pat.id INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON pa.created_by = u.id WHERE payroll_id = :payrollId AND deal_id = :dealId) history
xml.payroll.setStatus: UPDATE brs.payroll SET payroll_status_id = :payrollStatusId WHERE id = :payrollId
xml.payroll.status: SELECT p.payroll_status_id FROM brs.payroll p WHERE p.id = :payrollId
xml.payroll.addActionHistory: INSERT INTO brs.payroll_action_history (payroll_id, payroll_action_type_id, action_date, note, user_id) VALUES (:payrollId, :actionTypeId, now(), :note, :currentUserId)
xml.payroll.updatePayroll: UPDATE brs . payroll SET period_end = :periodEndDate::date, description = :description, updated_by = :currentUserId, selected_deal_ids = :dealIds::BIGINT[], updated = now() WHERE id = :payrollId
xml.payroll.checkSummaryPreparationStatus: SELECT state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query = 'select * from brs.refresh_summary_view() as result' AND state = 'active'
xml.payroll.getSummary: SELECT CASE WHEN p.payroll_status_id = 3 THEN brs.get_commission_summary_from_snapshot(p.id) ELSE brs.get_commission_summary(p.id) END FROM brs.payroll p WHERE id = :payrollId
xml.payroll.getOverrideDetailsByUser: SELECT CASE WHEN p.payroll_status_id = 3 THEN brs.get_overrides_earned_by_user_snapshot(p.id, :userId::int) ELSE brs.get_overrides_earned_by_user(p.id, :userId::int) END FROM brs.payroll p WHERE p.id = :payrollId
